author: blu
body: Reusable settings/properties panel. A vertical stack of labeled fields: dropdowns, text inputs, sliders (gauges), toggles, and static key-value pairs. Apps build a SettingsSpec, and the panel renders it with consistent spacing, label alignment, and validation error display.

author: blu
body: Every other field kind takes its widget identifier from the field's own id. A separator and a heading carry none, so they take the position they were declared at instead: two separators in one spec would otherwise answer to a single name, and a lookup by identifier returns the first of them.
